purge_time_s: 1 s after HfCl4 pulse or 3 s after TiCl4 or H2O pulses
evidence: The deposition temperature was 300°C, and the reactor pressure was 4 Torr. Each precursor pulse was separated by a purge with inert N2. The metal precursors were HfCl4 and TiCl4. The H2O was used as the oxygen source. The pulse lengths of the metal precursors were 0.1 s for HfCl4 and 0.2 s for TiCl4, respectively.
